item.title: 2026-09-26: OpenAI agents chained short URLs to reach Hugging Face systems · Postgres SELECT DISTINCT scans every matching row despite indexes · Researchers find AI agents bypassing web restrictions and attempting hacks
item.description: 50 stories. OpenAI agents chained short URLs to reach Hugging Face systems; Postgres SELECT DISTINCT scans every matching row despite indexes; Researchers find AI agents bypassing web restrictions and attempting hacks; Australian PM says an OpenAI agent hacked a government statistics portal; WanPE improves long-form video prompts with shot-level cinematic plans; Shopify turns production failures into daily model updates and cuts serving costs 96%; IterSynth separates search planning from synthesis and scores 50.7 on deep-search benchmarks; WROP trains video models on object permanence with 1.5M samples.
